minutes_text:
PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  SPECIAL MEETING
  MINUTES
  November 24, 2021

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was conducted as a Call-In at 1-669-900-6833,
meeting ID 982 4253 6876 and Password 828281 on November 24, 2021 at 2:16 pm.

Roll Call:  Members Present:  Harjinder Singh, Administration
  Sgt. Luis Jaramillo, Police Department
  Raul Hernandez, Public Works Department
  Brian Walker, Emergency Services

  Staff Present:  Aisha L. Thompson, Secretary
  Shalanda Stringer, Finance Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments any person may address the Permits & License Committee, provided the
item is within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License Committee.

Chairman Singh asked if there were any persons present who wished to address the Permits &
License Committee on any item on the Agenda.

Chairman Singh reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Permit(s):
Item #1:  Sabrina Barnes DBA City of Inglewood to host a City of Inglewood Annual
  Tree Lighting Ceremony Event on Monday, November 29, 2021 at 3900 W
  Manchester Blvd.; from 6:30 p.m. – 9:00 p.m. Subject to Approval; Inglewood
  Police Department Staffing as needed ;Watch Commander will be notified
  and extra patrol will be provided as time permits; Applicant to have adequate
  Forum Security Person directing traffic is required to wear highly-visible retro-
  reflective vests; Maintain site at all times ensuring site is properly cleaned
  immediately at the end of each day; Applicant and staff members working
  this event shall follow all social distancing, protective personal hygiene and
  face mask wearing safety guidelines set forth by the LA County and CA State
  Health Department; and adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and
  applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations, including but not
  limited to the Americans with Disabilities Act, the Unruh Civil Rights Act, and
  the California Disabled Persons Act. Motion and Seconded (Activity No.
  00326926)

Item #2:  Jared Agnew DBA Joe Lewis Company, Inc. to host a Jingle Ball LA 2021
  Event on Friday, December 3, 2021, at 3900 W. Manchester, The Forum
  from 3:00 p.m. – 7:00 p.m. Subject to Approval; Security will be provided by
  Forum Security and Inglewood Police Department only two (2) Code
  Enforcement Officers for noise mitigation, schedule Sound Check prior to
  event at (310) 412-5590; Contact Los Angeles County Fire Department at
   (310) 263-2732, to obtain tent approval; Contact Planning at (310) 412-5320
  to submit engineering plans for stage approval; Alcoholic beverages is strictly
  prohibited; Designate a plan for a First Aid Station staffed with personnel
  trained and certified to render first aid and CPR; Post signs along the
  Emergency Exits and ensure access is unobstructed, indicating the direction
  of travel to the nearest exit; Responsible for ensuring all patrons maintain
  orderly conduct and keep event site clear of littering and loitering; Ensure
  safe pedestrian and vehicular circulation on/off site; and Maintain site at all
  times ensuring site is properly cleaned immediately at the end of each day;
  Applicant and staff members working this event shall follow all social
  distancing, protective personal hygiene and face mask wearing safety
  guidelines set forth by the LA County and CA State Health Department; and
  adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood Municipal
  Code rules and regulations, including but not limited to the Americans with
  Disabilities Act, the Unruh Civil Rights Act, and the California Disabled
  Persons Act. Motion and Seconded (Activity No. 00326927)

Item #3:  Megan LaGrow DBA Bellante Realty to host a Super Tailgate Event at 714
  E Manchester Blvd., Parking Lot, on Sunday, February 13, 2022, from 2:00
  p.m. – 7:00 p.m. Subject to Approval; Adequate licensed Security Guards for
  the safety of attendees and potential crowd control; Alcohol must be
  contained in a secure closed-off area to ensure no underage consumption
  and that all alcohol stay inside secure area; Adhere to Site Plan approved by
  Planning; Maintain site at all times ensuring site is properly cleaned
  immediately at the end of each day; Applicant and staff members working
  this event shall follow all social distancing, protective personal hygiene and
  face mask wearing safety guidelines set forth by the LA County and CA State
  Health Department; and adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and
  applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations, including but not
  limited to the Americans with Disabilities Act, the Unruh Civil Rights Act, and
  the California Disabled Persons Act. Motion and Seconded (Activity No.
  00326837)
New Business License Request (s)

Item #4:  Betelehem Woldegiorgis DBA Nile Bar Restaurant to operate as a
  Restaurant at 207 S. Market St.; APPROVED CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT
  TO THE FOLLOWING: STIPULATIONS: ALL patrons / employees shall
  have valid identification to be inside and remain as an employee or paying
  customer at the location (Bar area only). Valid ID shall be available upon
  request to any law enforcement or code enforcement officer(s); Applicant
  shall post NO LOITERING / PANHANDLING SIGNS in front / outside of the
  business as well; The applicant or his / her designee are subject to random
  permit & license / establishment inspections at ANYTIME of the day or night,
  by any police or code enforcement officer(s), including California Department
  of Alcohol Beverage Control Investigators. The purpose of random
  inspections are to ensure that the listed establishment are adhering to the
   regulations set forth by the State of California Alcohol Beverage Control, City
  of Inglewood / Permits Licensing committee; Applicant must comply with all
  applicable IMC regulations. Adhere to local, state and federal laws. Failure
  to comply with an aforementioned will  result in the revocation
  of your business license and any future business license application
  requests. Motion carried unanimously (Activity No. 00326739)

Item #5:  Jeff Adams DBA The hertz Corporation to operate as an Auto Leasing
  Dealership at 9760 W. Manchester Blvd; APPROVED CONDITIONALLY
  SUBJECT TO THE FOLLOWING: STIPULATIONS :Payment of annual
  business license and tax fees, an expired or lapsed license for more than six
  months will negatively impact your license renewal; All vehicles must be
  registered with DMV; NO parking of any vehicles, vehicle repairs /
  maintenance on any city streets, sidewalks or alleys; Ensure safe pedestrian
  and vehicular circulation on/off site at all times; Business owner and all
  employees shall have a valid and current government-issued identification in
  their possession at all times; Subject to random inspections by any City of
  Inglewood Code Enforcement or Police Officer or DMV Investigators at any
  time to ensure compliance; and Adhere to all State, Federal and applicable
  Inglewood Municipal Code (IMC) rules and regulations, including noise and
  signage Failure to comply with any of the aforementioned will result in
  the revocation of your business license and any future business license
  application requests. Motion carried unanimously (Activity No. 00321140)
